name: Table 1-24: Bestial Archetypes
_doc: Determines the broad category of a Notable Species. Each archetype has a basic Profile and a Bestial Natures sub-table for refinement.

rows.name: Apex Predator
rows.description: Vicious species at the top of the local food chain. Profile: WS 58, S 48, T 45, Ag 48, Wounds 15, Natural Weapons (1d10+4 I/R, Primitive).

rows.name: Behemoth
rows.description: Vast lumbering creature, often placid but supremely territorial. Profile: WS 40, S 70, T 65, Wounds (large).

rows.name: Ptera-Beast
rows.description: Flying species dominating the skies. Aerial-combat capable.

rows.name: Shadowed Stalker
rows.description: Stealth-oriented species relying on concealment and ambush.

rows.name: Venomous Terror
rows.description: Poison-using species — venom-injection or atmospheric toxin emission.
